description: Search the Corte costituzionale case law (pronunce and massime, CC BY-SA 3.0 open data) by text, meaning or both. Hybrid mode fuses full-text (italian) and vector ranking with reciprocal rank fusion; massime outrank decisions when equally close. Each hit is a massima or a pronuncia (source), with ecli, massima_numero, titolo, headline (text highlight, null for purely semantic hits), snippet, source_url and its position. Parameters: query (web-search syntax: "exact phrase", word OR word, -excluded), k (1..50, default 10), mode (hybrid, lexical, semantic), filters tipologia (S sentenza, O ordinanza), anno_from, anno_to, relatore (substring), deposito_from and deposito_to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). At least a query or one filter is required; filters alone list decisions ordered by ECLI. There is no numeric score: results are in relevance order. Example: {"query": "licenziamento illegittimo", "tipologia": "S", "k": 5}.
